svg.title: Fold a distribution around its median to find MAD
svg.desc: The upper illustrative curve shows log token counts. Its inner weighted median divides reference weight equally between the left and right sides. Taking absolute distances folds both sides onto nonnegative distances in the lower curve. Its outer weighted median divides reference weight equally between smaller and larger distances; this is MAD. Curve area represents reference weight. The asymmetric, two-peaked shape is illustrative, not measured token data. The lower density is obtained by adding the upper density at equal distances on both sides of its median.
